args: In lcms/src/cmsxform.c, why does AllocEmptyTransform permit both InputFormat and OutputFormat to be zero, and are there legitimate internal callers that rely on constructing a transform with both formats zero and later installing formatters? What is the safest root-cause fix consistent with API behavior?

The reported crash occurs when cmsCreateTransform is called with attacker-controlled srcFormat=0 and dstFormat=0. AllocEmptyTransform accepts the pair due to a special conditional around lines 913-916, leaves p->FromInput and p->ToOutput NULL, installs CachedXFORM or another ordinary worker, and cmsDoTransform then calls the NULL FromInput callback. I have not yet modified code. I need to determine whether rejecting the all-zero pair could break any legitimate internal path, or whether a special no-op worker/formatter setup is intended by this special case.
